# VakayGo — Travel Directory for the Caribbean, Latin America & the Mediterranean

> VakayGo is a travel directory covering stays, tours, excursions, restaurants, transport, transfers, spas and local guides in 34 destinations across the Caribbean, Latin America and the Mediterranean. Online booking is available only on listings whose business has claimed the listing and completed setup; every other listing is information only.

## What VakayGo is
- **Website:** https://vakaygo.com
- **Coverage:** 34 destinations in three regions (listed below).
- **Listing types:** stays, tours, excursions, dining, events, transport, transfers, VIP services, spas and local guides.
- **Operated by:** Avmere, 240 Richmond St W, Toronto, ON M5V 1V6, Canada.

## How listings and bookings work
- Most listings are built from public information about a business. A listing says on its page whether the business has claimed it.
- A business can claim its listing for free and manage its details.
- A listing takes bookings on VakayGo only after its business has claimed it and completed setup. Each listing page shows whether it can be booked for the selected dates.
- Where booking is available, travelers pay no VakayGo booking fee; the business pays a commission.
- Ratings shown on listings that have not been claimed come from Google. VakayGo does not publish its own safety or quality ratings for destinations.
- Prices, hours and availability can change. Confirm details with the business.
